g.text: Complex-aware steering increases predicted pH selectivity
TNF designs with target context; linkage and structural yield are evaluated separately.
C-E: points are designs with a retained pose; black bars are medians; dashed lines mark the source complex. Labels give scored/total designs.
Surface arms use eight refolds per design; linkage arms use one. Predictions are binder-site linkage contributions, not measured affinities.
